hero.headline: Staff Outsourcing & HR Management in Nigeria
hero.sub: We manage the people side of your business, from sourcing and payroll to compliance and HR administration, so you can focus on running the business, not the paperwork.

intro: Every growing business reaches a point where managing people becomes its own full-time job. Payroll has to go out correctly and on time. Pension and tax remittances have to be filed without error. New hires need onboarding, exiting staff need proper offboarding, and somewhere in between, someone has to keep track of attendance, performance, and the paperwork that protects the business if anything goes wrong. Most founders did not start their business to manage all of that, and most internal teams are not built to carry it at scale.

Traction Outsourcing takes on the staffing and HR administration work directly, so your outsourced staff show up, perform, and get paid correctly, while the compliance and management weight sits with us instead of you. This is not a call center reading from a script. We look at how your business actually operates before we place a single person, then build the staffing and HR support around that reality.

full_service.title: The Full Service
full_service.sub: Staff outsourcing done properly covers far more than placing people. Every client engagement includes the full lifecycle below, managed by our team so yours does not have to.

entries.title: Staff Recruitment and Placement
entries.text: We source, screen, and place staff matched to the role using our bespoke recruitment solutions that draw from a pre-vetted community of candidates ready to work.

entries.title: Payroll Administration
entries.text: Accurate, timely payroll processing with full compliance to Nigerian statutory requirements including PAYE, pension, and NHF remittances.

entries.title: Employee Lifecycle Management
entries.text: From onboarding to exit, we run the HR processes that keep your workforce organised, documented, and audit-ready at every stage.

entries.title: HR Policy & Compliance
entries.text: We build and maintain the policy handbooks, SLAs, and staff documentation your business needs to stay protected and consistent.

entries.title: Performance & Attendance Oversight
entries.text: We track attendance and follow up on performance so issues surface early instead of becoming problems your team discovers too late.

entries.title: HR Advisory & Structural Support
entries.text: When your organisational structure needs to change, we design the framework and manage the transition, tying into our restructuring service where needed.

deliverables.title: What Your Workforce Outsourcing Engagement Includes
deliverables.sub: Every outsourced staff member placed by Traction Outsourcing Limited goes through this process. No exceptions.

entries.title: Pre-Employment Training
entries.text: All candidates receive structured pre-employment training before placement, covering workplace readiness and role-specific preparation.

entries.title: Skills-Based Evaluation
entries.text: Every candidate undergoes practical skills assessment tests specific to the role before being presented to a client.

entries.title: Pre-Employment IQ Testing
entries.text: Standardised IQ assessments are administered to all candidates as part of our structured vetting process.

entries.title: Background Checks
entries.text: Comprehensive background checks are conducted on all confirmed staff before they resume, covering identity, history, and references.

entries.title: Medical Checks
entries.text: A compulsory medical check is included in the onboarding process for every outsourced staff member placed by Traction Outsourcing Limited.

entries.title: Full Onboarding Experience
entries.text: We manage the entire onboarding process, including documentation, orientation, policy handover, and role briefing, before the staff member begins work.

entries.title: Immediate Staff Replacement
entries.text: Where a placed staff member does not work out, Traction Outsourcing provides a replacement. Terms apply by staff cadre.

entries.title: Nationwide Recruitment
entries.text: We recruit and place staff for businesses across Nigeria, not only in Abuja. Our reach covers all 36 states and the FCT.

entries.title: Quarterly Corporate Check-Ins
entries.text: Our management team conducts quarterly check-ins, both physical and virtual, with all outsourced staff to monitor welfare, performance, and engagement.

entries.title: Bi-Annual Group Training
entries.text: All outsourced staff receive bi-annual group training sessions, customised per client to address role-specific development and business alignment.

entries.title: Payroll Management
entries.text: Full payroll processing handled on your behalf, with accurate computation, timely disbursement, and complete records maintained by our team.

entries.title: Pension, Tax & Statutory Deductions
entries.text: We handle all statutory obligations including PAYE remittance, pension contributions, NHF, ITF, and NSITF on behalf of your outsourced workforce.

why_choose.title: Why Businesses Choose Us for Workforce Outsourcing

entries.title: HR-Certified Leadership
entries.text: Our practice is led by PHRi, SHRM-SCP, and CIPM certified HR professionals, not generalists managing staffing as a side function.

entries.title: One Partner, Not Five Vendors
entries.text: Sourcing using our bespoke recruitment methods, structuring through our business advisory team, and staff outsourcing all sit under one roof.

entries.title: 24/7 Virtual Client Support
entries.text: Reach us at any hour through our round-the-clock support desk, not just during standard business hours.

entries.title: Hands-On, Not Hands-Off
entries.text: We start by understanding how your business actually operates, then build the staffing and HR structure around that reality.

entries.a: Staff outsourcing is when a business hands over the sourcing, payroll, compliance, and day-to-day management of a set of employees to a specialist firm, while those staff continue working within the client's business. It removes the administrative and legal weight of employment without removing the workforce itself.

entries.q: What is the difference between staff outsourcing and recruitment?
entries.a: Recruitment ends once a candidate is placed and the client takes over as employer. Staff outsourcing continues after placement. Traction Outsourcing remains responsible for payroll, compliance, HR administration, and ongoing management of that staff member for as long as the arrangement runs.

link.label: See our recruitment brand, ATH Recruiters.

entries.q: Does Traction Outsourcing handle payroll and pension remittance?
entries.a: Yes. Payroll administration, including PAYE, pension, NHF, ITF, and NSITF remittances, is a core part of the staff outsourcing service, run to Nigerian statutory requirements.

entries.q: Can Traction Outsourcing manage staff outside Abuja?
entries.a: Yes. Traction Outsourcing manages outsourced staff for businesses across Nigeria, not only in Abuja, and recruits and places staff in all 36 states and the FCT. Payroll, compliance, and HR administration are handled remotely and consistently regardless of where the staff are based.

entries.q: How does Traction Outsourcing vet staff before placement?
entries.a: Every outsourced staff member goes through pre-employment training, a skills-based evaluation specific to the role, and a pre-employment IQ test. Background checks covering identity, history, and references and a compulsory medical check follow for confirmed staff, and we manage the full onboarding before the person starts work.

link.label: Read: What Does Staff Outsourcing Actually Include?

entries.q: What happens if a placed staff member does not work out?
entries.a: Traction Outsourcing provides a replacement. The terms apply by staff cadre, so ask our team for the terms that match the role you need.

entries.q: Which industries does Traction Outsourcing provide outsourced staff for?
entries.a: We support real estate and construction, hospitality and food service, retail and consumer goods, automotive services, financial services, engineering and technical firms, mining and minerals, agriculture, technology, banks, consulting and professional services, and government ministries, among others.

entries.q: What types of roles can I outsource?
entries.a: Roles include front desk and customer service, administrative and back office, sales and business development, facility and property support, hospitality staff, drivers and logistics support, and finance and accounts support. We also place graduate interns, SIWES interns, NYSC corps members, and senior interns.

entries.q: How does the staff outsourcing process work?
entries.a: It runs in three stages. We diagnose your staffing gaps and what the business actually needs, design the role and the staffing plan, then deploy: we place the staff, run payroll and compliance from day one, and stay responsible for management and performance for as long as the arrangement runs.

entries.q: How is outsourced staff managed after placement?
entries.a: Our team stays responsible for payroll, compliance, attendance and performance oversight, and HR administration. We also hold quarterly check-ins, both physical and virtual, with outsourced staff and run bi-annual group training sessions customised for each client.

entries.q: How much does staff outsourcing cost in Nigeria?
entries.a: The cost depends on the number of staff, the roles, and the services included, such as payroll, HR administration, and training. Traction Outsourcing prepares a quote after a free 30-minute consultation.

entries.q: How do I get started with staff outsourcing?
entries.a: Use the Request A Free Consultation form on this page, or book a call, and someone from our team will reach out to understand your staffing needs before proposing a plan.
